_help: Fallback for banks centralbank.watch does not publish probabilities for (it links out to CME FedWatch for the Fed, and omits the RBNZ). Fill hike/hold/cut as percentages plus next_meeting and src. Set "override": true to beat a scraped value. Leave a bank out entirely rather than guessing - a missing expectation is handled, an invented one is not.
_note_USD: 16 Sep FOMC hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00% (confirmed) with a hawkish dot plot (16 of 18 officials expect at least one more hike this year). That meeting has now passed, so the prior entry (which pointed at it) is stale - decision-day trap. No credible market-implied probability for the next meeting (28 Oct) was found: WebSearch turned up only the qualitative dot-plot signal, and the internal Fed Watch model (data/fedwatch.json) is currently broken post-hike (still using the pre-hike EFFR/target range as of 15 Sep, producing a nonsensical Dec reading). Left out entirely rather than guessing - re-research once a clean Oct 28 figure is available.

JPY.src: researched 2026-10-08: OIS implies ~12% for a 30 Oct hike rising to ~90% by December (KuCoin/market wrap), another tracker shows 83% no-change; 15/85 used as the mid. Most economists expect a hold. Prior: 22% on 30 Sep.

EUR.src: researched 2026-10-06: LSEG data (Bloomberg/Reuters on Nagel, 5 Oct) price ~20% for a 29 Oct hike and ~80% for December; economists mostly see the ECB skipping October after Lagarde's 'measured response' (28 Sep). Prior: 60% on 24 Sep.

NZD.src: researched 2026-10-06: markets priced ~80% for a 25bp OCR hike to 3.00% on 28 Oct as of 1 Oct (Vantage Markets, FXStreet 28 Sep 'hike bets keep building'). centralbank.watch's ~88% hold snapshot is stale. Prior: 75% on 27 Sep.

CAD.src: researched 2026-10-06: snapshots conflict - money.ca/refdesk OIS as of 2 Oct imply ~74% hold (+7bp), other trackers (bluegamma etc.) show ~41-43% hike; 35/65 used as the mid. Odds fell from 59% on 25 Sep as US yields/oil eased and Williams signalled no urgency.

_note_CAD: Rate-odds source rotated to public reporting after bankofcanadaodds.com; the TradingView scrape carries a stale 5.25% BoC rate and no real BoC block, so override stays true. If a cleaner current feed appears, prefer it.
